ic_name: MIPI SPMI v2.0 + RFFE v3.0 (System Power Management + RF Front-End Control)

spec_provided_observability.name: SPMI Device Descriptor Block (DDB)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read manufacturer/product/revision/function for discovery and enumeration.

spec_provided_observability.name: RFFE product/manufacturer ID registers
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identify the RFFE slave and its USID/GSID.

spec_provided_observability.name: RFFE Interrupt Read / Identification & Clearing
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Discover which slave(s) raised an interrupt and clear it.

spec_provided_observability.name: Per-frame odd parity
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Detects bus bit errors; a parity mismatch is observable as an ignored frame.

spec_provided_observability.name: SPMI arbitration / Request
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observe which master wins and which slave requested service.

spec_provided_observability.name: Register read-back
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Register Read / Extended Register Read give live device state for monitoring/debug.

interrupt_sources.trigger: Master detected arbitration loss on SDA.
Receiver returned NACK when ACK expected.
Illegal condition (START or STOP at unexpected position).

interrupt_request: Interrupts are SoC-controller-specific; UM10204 lists the canonical conditions observable at the protocol layer.
notes: SPMI/RFFE observability is in-band over the two wires: DDB / ID registers for discovery, register read-back for state, RFFE interrupt handling for events, and per-frame parity for integrity. There is no separate scan/JTAG layer in the protocol; chip-level DFT is the device implementer's concern.
error_detection_mechanisms: Odd parity per command/address/data frame detects bit errors.
SPMI arbitration resolves multi-master contention deterministically.
Missing/invalid SSC or Bus Park leaves the bus idle (no spurious transaction).
RFFE interrupt mechanism surfaces slave-side events.
SPMI Authenticated commands gate protected-register access.
